name: Faun Drome Classic
story: An early break of seven was caught on the Col de La Granda Limite, where Mattias Skjelmose, Ben Tulett, and Lenny Martinez attacked but were brought back. At 17km from the finish, Romain Gregoire and Matteo Jorgenson broke clear, building a 40-second lead. The peloton nearly came back, but Gregoire held on to win ahead of Jorgenson. Lenny Martinez was the strongest finisher in the peloton and became third.
